text: I was charged twice for the same transaction and I need this resolved immediately. If not, I will escalate.
response: I understand your concern about the duplicate charge and will forward your request to our Billing Department for immediate review [duplicate_charges.md]. They are best equipped to investigate the specific transaction details and process any necessary refunds according to our policy timelines. Please allow them a moment to assist you further.

text: My statement shows two identical charges of 45.50 JOD from Carrefour on March 3rd. Can you check?
response: I am forwarding your request regarding the duplicate Carrefour charges to our Billing Department for further investigation [fees_and_charges.md]. To assist them better, could you please confirm if these transactions occurred on the same day or at different times?

text: Why was I charged a fee for using another bank's ATM?
response: Your fee for using another bank's ATM abroad consists of a 5 JOD fixed charge plus 1.5% of the transaction amount [fees_and_charges.md]. This information has been forwarded to our Billing Department for further assistance. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your account?

text: I cancelled my gym membership in January but they keep charging my card every month. I want these charges reversed.
response: I understand your frustration regarding the recurring charges after cancelling your gym membership in January [disputes_and_chargebacks.md]. Since this involves a merchant keeping charges after cancellation, I can assist you with filing a dispute for these transactions [disputes_and_chargebacks.md]. Please note that fee refunds are generally not offered unless the card was cancelled within 30 days of the charge being applied [fees_and_charges.md], so we will focus on disputing the specific gym charges. Would you like me to proceed with initiating a dispute for these amounts?

text: The ATM didn't give me any cash but my account was debited 200 JOD. This is unacceptable, I need my money back today.
response: I understand your frustration regarding the debit of 200 JOD without cash receipt, but our policy states that ATM cash not dispensed is automatically returned within 2 business days [atm_cash_not_dispensed.md]. Since you are requesting an immediate refund today, this request has been escalated to our Billing Department for further assistance.

text: Can I get my annual card fee refunded? I barely used the card this year.
response: I understand you would like a refund for your annual card fee, but Nova Bank does not offer fee refunds based on low usage [fees_and_charges.md]. The only exceptions are if the fee was waived due to spending over 2,000 JOD or if the card was cancelled within 30 days of the charge. Since this request is handled by the Billing Department, I have forwarded it to them for further assistance.

text: I paid my credit card bill on time but was still charged a late payment fee.
response: I understand your concern about the late payment fee despite paying on time. According to our policy, if your payment was made on or before the due date but posted late due to a bank delay, the fee can be reversed upon request [fees_and_charges.md]. Since this involves billing adjustments, I have forwarded your case to the Billing Department for further review.

text: An online store charged me in USD and the conversion fee is way higher than I expected.
response: Regarding your online store transaction in USD, Nova Bank applies a standard 2.5% currency conversion fee for foreign currency card transactions [fees_and_charges.md]. While merchants abroad may offer dynamic currency conversion (JOD), their rates are often less favorable than the bank's rate. Please note that this specific inquiry is being handled by our Billing Department.

text: I returned a laptop to the shop two weeks ago and the refund still hasn't reached my account.
response: I understand your concern regarding the delayed refund for your laptop return. According to our policy, merchant refunds after a product return typically take 5 to 14 business days to appear on your account [disputes_and_chargebacks.md]. Since this matter involves billing and refund processing, I have forwarded your request to the Billing Department for further assistance.

text: You've charged me an overdraft fee three months in a row even though I have overdraft protection. Third time I'm complaining. Fix this now.
response: I understand your frustration regarding the repeated overdraft fees despite having protection [fees_and_charges.md]. Since this involves a pattern of charges rather than a single error, I have escalated your case to our Billing Department for immediate review and resolution. Please allow them a short time to contact you directly with the refund process.

text: There's a 350 JOD transaction on my card from a website I've never heard of. I didn't make this purchase.
response: I understand your concern regarding the unauthorized 350 JOD transaction, and I will escalate this matter immediately to our Fraud Team for investigation [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md]. Please note that while small charges can sometimes be test transactions, any amount must be treated as potential fraud until proven otherwise. Our team will contact you shortly with further steps to secure your card and resolve the issue.

text: I got an SMS asking me to confirm my card details on a link, and I think I entered them. What should I do?
response: Since no policy text is available regarding this issue, your request has been forwarded to the Fraud Team for assistance. To help them assist you better, could you please confirm whether you received any notification that your card details were successfully updated?

text: My wallet was stolen this morning with my debit card inside. Please block it now!
response: I am sorry to hear about your wallet theft; I will escalate this request to our Fraud Team immediately [lost_stolen_and_blocked_cards.md]. Please note that while we can issue a replacement card within 5 business days, there is a fee of 5 JOD unless you provide a police report [lost_stolen_and_blocked_cards.md].

text: Someone called me pretending to be from the bank and asked for my OTP. I didn't give it but I'm worried.
response: Thank you for reporting this suspicious call to us [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md]. Please be assured that Nova Bank never asks for OTPs by phone or SMS [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md], so your account remains safe. Since you shared no personal information, we will forward your report to the Fraud Team to warn other customers [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md].

text: Hi, just a quick question, I noticed a small charge of 1 JOD from a company I don't recognize. Is that normal?
response: I have forwarded your request regarding the unrecognized 1 JOD charge to our Fraud Team, as small unknown charges are often test transactions used by fraudsters [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md]. Please allow them some time to investigate and provide you with a resolution.

text: Multiple withdrawals I didn't make happened overnight in another country. My account is almost empty!!!
response: I am sorry to hear about your account situation, but I do not have access to transaction details or fraud investigation capabilities [fees_and_charges.md], [duplicate_charges.md], [card_usage_and_renewal.md]. This request is being escalated to our Fraud Team for immediate assistance.

text: I was charged twice for a hotel booking and one of the charges is from a city I've never been to.
response: I understand your concern about the duplicate hotel booking charge and the unexpected city fee. Since this involves potential fraud or unauthorized transactions, I have escalated your case to our Fraud Team for further investigation [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md]. They will review the details of both charges to determine if they are legitimate test charges or errors.

text: I received an email saying my account is suspended and I need to log in through a link. Is this really from you?
response: No, Nova Bank never sends login links via email [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md], and this request is being escalated to our Fraud Team for further assistance. Please do not click any links or share personal details as we never ask for your PIN, card number, password, or OTP through these channels [fraud_and_unauthorized_transactions.md].

text: My card was declined at the supermarket even though I have enough balance.
response: Your card was likely declined because your daily limit has been reached, it is not enabled for online or international use, or the card has expired [lost_stolen_and_blocked_cards.md]. Since this issue involves account services, I have forwarded your request to the appropriate team who can assist you further.

text: The ATM swallowed my card. How do I get it back?
response: Since your card was retained by an ATM, it will be kept at the branch for 7 days [lost_stolen_and_blocked_cards.md]. You can collect it there with a valid ID during this period. Please note that cards retained by other banks' ATMs are destroyed and replaced free of charge [lost_stolen_and_blocked_cards.md].

text: My card expires next month. Will a new one be sent automatically?
response: Yes, your card will be renewed automatically [card_usage_and_renewal.md]. A new card will be sent to your registered branch 30 days before expiry, and you will receive an SMS notification [card_usage_and_renewal.md]. This request has been forwarded to Account Services for further assistance.

text: I entered the wrong PIN three times and now my card is blocked. I'm travelling tomorrow and need it working!
response: I understand your urgency, but our policy states that after three wrong PIN attempts, the card is automatically blocked for security [lost_stolen_and_blocked_cards.md]. Since this requires account-specific verification to unblock or reset your PIN, I am escalating your request to Account Services who can assist you further.

text: Can I increase the daily withdrawal limit on my debit card?
response: Yes, you can increase your daily ATM withdrawal limit up to 3,000 JOD [card_usage_and_renewal.md]. This change can be made immediately through the app under the "Card limits" section [card_usage_and_renewal.md]. Please note that your default purchase limit remains at 3,000 JOD [card_usage_and_renewal.md].

text: Is it possible to use my card in Turkey or do I have to activate something first?
response: Your card is currently set to disable international usage by default [card_usage_and_renewal.md], so you will need to enable "Use abroad" in the app before traveling to Turkey. This feature can be activated for specific countries and date ranges within your account settings [card_usage_and_renewal.md]. Please note that online (e-commerce) transactions can also be managed separately in the app [card_usage_and_renewal.md].

text: I can't log in to the mobile app, it keeps saying my password is incorrect.
response: I understand you are unable to log in due to incorrect password errors. According to our policy, after five failed attempts, your account may be temporarily locked [online_banking_access.md]. Since this issue requires further assistance with access recovery, I have escalated your request to the Account Services team.

text: My online banking got locked after too many attempts. How long until it unlocks?
response: Your online banking will unlock automatically after 30 minutes following the lockout [online_banking_access.md]. If you experience another lock on the same day, you will need to reset your password using the "Forgot password" feature in the app [online_banking_access.md]. Please note that this request is being handled by Account Services.

text: I changed my phone number and now I'm not receiving the OTP codes to log in.
response: To resolve your issue with receiving OTP codes, you must update your registered mobile number at a branch or ATM using your card and PIN [online_banking_access.md]. Once the update is processed, the new number will be active within 1 hour [online_banking_access.md]. Please visit a Nova Bank location to complete this change.

text: I haven't been able to access my account for 3 days, nobody answers the phone, and I have bills due tomorrow. This is ridiculous.
response: I understand your frustration regarding the access issues and billing concerns. I have escalated your request to our Account Services team for immediate assistance [complaints_handling.md]. Please note that while we are reviewing your case, every complaint receives a reference number and an acknowledgement within one business day [complaints_handling.md].

text: How do I update my home address?
response: To update your home address, please contact Account Services directly as this request is handled by that team [online_banking_access.md]. Our current policy documents focus on mobile number updates and login access rather than address changes.

text: What documents do I need to open a savings account?
response: To open a savings account with Nova Bank, you must maintain a minimum balance of 100 JOD [fees_and_charges.md]. Once your account is opened, please note that a monthly fee of 1 JOD applies if the balance falls below this threshold. As this request involves account services, I have forwarded it to the appropriate team for assistance.

text: How do I close my account?

text: What is the minimum balance for a savings account?

text: What's the interest rate for a personal loan?
response: The personal loan interest rate is from 7.5% (fixed, annual) for salaried customers who transfer their salary to Nova Bank [account_opening_and_changes.md], or 9% otherwise [personal_loans.md]. Please note that the maximum term for these loans is 8 years [account_opening_and_changes.md]. As this request is handled by Account Services, I will forward your inquiry to them shortly.

text: I want to pay off my car loan early. Is there a penalty?
response: Yes, there is an early settlement fee of 1% of your remaining principal for paying off your car loan early [account_opening_and_changes.md]. However, this fee is waived if your loan has been older than 3 years [personal_loans.md]. Would you like to proceed with the early repayment?

text: My loan installment was deducted twice this month.
response: I have forwarded your request regarding the duplicate deduction to our Billing Department, as this issue is handled under our Duplicate Charges Policy [duplicate_charges.md]. Please note that such refunds are typically processed within 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with while we wait for their response?

text: I applied for a loan two weeks ago and haven't heard anything back.

Please allow a few more days for your case to be finalized. If you have any questions about the status during this time, feel free to reach out again.

text: Can I postpone this month's loan payment? I lost my job.
response: Yes, you can request a payment deferral due to job loss, as this qualifies as hardship under our policy [account_opening_and_changes.md]. Please note that interest will continue to accrue during the deferral period, and requests must be made at least 5 days before your installment date. Since this is handled by Account Services, I have forwarded your request to them for further assistance.

text: What are your branch opening hours on Saturday?

As this inquiry requires specific branch verification, I have forwarded your request to the Support Team.

I have forwarded your specific inquiry to the Support Team for further assistance.

text: How much does it cost to send money abroad?
